digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud and Data Center reconcilers)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) have hardened test coverage grown from different development paths, creating bidirectional gaps where behaviors shared between adapters lack coverage on one side
Data Center adapter's field values, sanitizer boundaries, and probe branches must be pinned by value with shared map_fields_to_remote exercised through both WikiTextCodec and AdfCodec

Data Center adapter's comment and description length convergence must be proven across multiple passes with explicit citation of the admin-configurable WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT constant and its provenance
A single authoritative ticket-type map definition must exist within adapters/ with automated guard assertions to prevent duplicates, matching existing guards on status and priority maps
Vacuous tests must either assert the contract their docstring names or be renamed to reflect actual behavior; none may be deleted to preserve intent
All pins and rewrites must be mutation-checked with results recorded as evidence that test assertions can fail against mutated code
